gaps.sentence: We rely ___ public transport to get to work.
Over two hundred athletes participated ___ the marathon.
gaps.explanation: participate IN an event (also: take part in).

gaps.sentence: The surgeon operated ___ the patient for four hours.
gaps.explanation: operate ON a patient (for a condition).

gaps.sentence: She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: The lorry crashed ___ the back of the bus.
We're hoping ___ the best results this season.
gaps.explanation: hope FOR something = want and expect it.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry ___ the exam — you're well prepared.
